text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm-mm, Italian food is so delicious!
There's
pasta, risotto, Neapolitan pizza...
And then tiramisu and panna cotta for
dessert!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But I can't leave out the Belgian waffles.
Oh, and
don't forget the nata de
coco! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Sugar is energy, so it's okay to have as
long as I
burn it off later! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wow, look at all this food! It looks so
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Teehee! It certainly does, doesn't it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing that you can eat so much
and stay fit!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I have to work out more so I can eat as
much as
you without gaining weight!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I can't go on like this...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm going to get even more
ultra-hyped up
than usual today!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I can't betray the expectations of Spe
and
everyone else who looks up to me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A hot rod not only has to run great, but
it has to
look great too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Motivated by everyone's expectations,

Maruzensky successfully maintains a
healthy diet.
